title: SellAll
description:
I saw no-one had a upto-date free sellall paper plugin that doesnt interfere with economy plugins so, here we are!
I made this plugin as my first plugin which is easily configurable
body:
I saw no-one had a upto-date free sellall paper plugin that doesnt interfere with economy plugins so, here we are!
I made this plugin as my first plugin which is easily configurable

Default permission = sellall.command.use

Op Permission = sellall.command.admin
To reload the config type /sellall reload
